calendar.why: A hold at 3.75%-4.00% is expected; any hint of a hike would move bonds, the U.S. dollar, stocks and crypto.

calendar.label: U.S. Q3 GDP and September PCE inflation (8:30 a.m. ET); ECB decision; Amazon, Coinbase and Strategy earnings
calendar.why: PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge; Coinbase and Strategy results are reads on crypto activity.

calendar.label: Bank of Japan decision; large monthly bitcoin options expiry
calendar.why: Big options expiries can pull prices toward popular strike levels.

calendar.label: Apple earnings (after the close); Bitway (BTW) and Quack AI (Q) token unlocks
calendar.why: Apple is the largest index weight; newly unlocked tokens can add selling pressure.

calendar.label: U.S. midterm elections; AMD earnings (after the close)
calendar.why: The result could shape oil, the Iran conflict and risk appetite.

calendar.label: Zcash NU7 upgrade (about 7:50 p.m. ET)
calendar.why: Upgrade events often bring sharp price swings.

calendar.label: U.S. October jobs report (8:30 a.m. ET)
calendar.why: A strong report could push yields higher and raise the odds of a Fed hike.

calendar.label: Bank of Canada (9:45 a.m. ET) and Fed (2 p.m. ET) rate decisions
calendar.why: Both central banks decide the same day; the Bank of Canada has said more hikes are possible.
